sloka: जग्मतुः त्रिदिवम् राम कृतार्थौ इति नः श्रुतम् ।एष देशः स काकुत्स्थ महेन्द्रात् अद्युषितः पुरा ॥१-४७-१०॥
transliteration: jagmatuḥ tridivam rāma kṛtārthau iti naḥ śrutam ।eṣa deśaḥ sa kākutstha mahendrāt adyuṣitaḥ purā ॥1-47-10॥

translations.english: "O Descendant of Kakustha (Rama) this is that country which was formerly inhabited by Indra. Here Indra attended on Diti who achieved the fruit of her austerities.
